seo_title: WordPress to Custom CMS Migration | LANZAESTUDIO
seo_desc: Is your website taking forever to load? We eradicate heavy plugins by migrating your platform to an ultra-fast custom CMS with integrated AI.
author_pitch: I am tired of seeing companies lose sales because their WordPress is saturated with plugins and takes forever to load. My team builds ultra-fast custom dashboards, with integrated AI, so your website flies and you regain total control without relying on outdated templates.
title: Say goodbye to your slow WordPress: Migration to an ultra-fast custom CMS
body:
Is your website taking an eternity to load due to a saturated content management system?

Systems like WordPress, Joomla, or Drupal are famous for ending up as slow and heavy monsters. By constantly adding plugins, modules, and widgets for any small feature, your website's code collapses. The result is a page that takes three seconds (or more) to display. In the B2B environment, an executive doesn't wait; if your website doesn't load instantly, they close the tab and go straight to the competition, making you lose sales opportunities every hour.

The trap of Plugins and Heavy Templates

Trying to solve the slowness by installing more cache plugins or paying for a more expensive server is a useless patch. The real problem is the generic architecture and the junk code underneath. A tractor engine won't win a Formula 1 race no matter how many stickers you put on it.

Our solution: Headless Architecture and Exclusive CMS

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we extract all your content from that toxic ecosystem and migrate it to a modern, custom architecture. We build you a luxury, exclusive dashboard, and we make your website load in 0.2 seconds.

  1. Junk Code Eradication: We eliminate all heavy plugins and visual builders, programming from scratch only the exact functionalities your business needs.
  2. Extreme Loading in 0.2 Seconds: We deploy your website with modern static generation technologies, achieving a loading speed in milliseconds that both your clients and Google will love.
  3. Luxury Private Dashboard: We design a custom administration panel that is clean and intuitive, with no confusing menus, third-party advertising, or constant update warnings.
  4. AI-Enhanced Content: We integrate Artificial Intelligence engines directly into your new manager so you can instantly optimize, translate, and expand your texts right from the dashboard.

The Real Impact on your Digital Presence

  • Drastic Conversion Increase: By loading without delays, the bounce rate plummets, and your corporate clients navigate smoothly until they request a quote.
  • Unbreakable Security: With no vulnerable open-source code or third-party patches, your platform becomes completely immune to the massive hacks typical of WordPress.
  • Frustration-Free Management: Your team will update the company's content in seconds from an environment designed exclusively for their comfort and speed.
